note: Literature explicitly documents MSL2 variants in Karayol-Borroto-Haghshenas syndrome as associated with autism spectrum disorder and directly compares MSL2, MSL3, and KAT8 clinical phenotypes.

evidence.text: De novo variants in MSL2 were characterized in a cohort of 25 individuals presenting with neurodevelopmental phenotypes including global developmental delay, intellectual disability, and behavioral/psychiatric conditions such as autism spectrum disorder.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: Using exome sequencing, here we identify a cohort of 25 individuals with heterozygous de novo variants in MSL complex member MSL2. MSL2 variants were associated with NDD phenotypes including global developmental delay, intellectual disability, hypotonia, and motor issues such as coordination problems, feeding difficulties, and gait disturbance. Dysmorphisms and behavioral and/or psychiatric conditions, including autism spectrum disorder, and to a lesser extent, seizures, connective tissue disease signs, sleep disturbance, vision problems, and other organ anomalies, were observed in affected individuals.

evidence.text: Studies investigating MSL2 disruption and autism-like behaviors explicitly collect and compare clinical phenotype data across MSL2, MSL3, and KAT8 case cohorts.

source.title: MSL2 disruption leads to autism-like behaviors, impairs neurogenesis, and alters histone H4K16 acetylation
